description: assetra is a Python package from the University of Michigan ASSET Lab for electricity resource-adequacy analysis. The public documentation describes Monte Carlo state sampling, time-varying forced outage rates for thermal plants, sequential storage dispatch and user-defined generator types. Inputs are demand, supply-unit attributes, outage probabilities and study dates. Outputs include expected unserved energy, loss-of-load hours, loss-of-load days and loss-of-load frequency for the modelled system. Geographic coverage and time step follow the supplied power system and demand series. MIT-licensed source, PyPI distribution and documentation are free. A limitation is that adequacy metrics depend on the outage assumptions and dispatch simplifications; they do not automatically describe network outages or cascading failure. It supports capacity and reliability planning. The catalogue's model-pandapower addresses network physics, a different layer of electricity reliability; no coupling was checked. No Monte Carlo experiment was executed.
name: assetra probabilistic resource-adequacy simulator
